serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I went to the shop again…
After the last time I had some doubts about that cashier.
She looks like a bot and her coldness reminds me of {f_botName} when she just learned how to speak, but she said some things that made me doubt a little.
Does my gut tell me wrong? Could she be just a regular human with an irregular body?
I wish there was an easy way to find that out, but there isn’t.
She’s very good at shutting down people, so maybe instead of trying to talk the answer out of her I should try observing her a little.
Aside from more clues she may make some mistake that will give me definitive proof.
